enrollment_requirements.question: What are the enrollment requirements?
enrollment_requirements.answer: For freshmen: Report Card (Form 138), Certificate of Good Moral Character, PSA Birth Certificate, 2x2 ID photos (4 copies), and Medical Certificate. For transferees: Honorable Dismissal, Transcript of Records, and the same documents above.

enrollment_deadline.question: When is the deadline for enrollment?
enrollment_deadline.answer: Regular enrollment ends on August 15. Late enrollment is accepted until August 20 with a penalty fee of ₱500. Classes start on August 22.

tuition_payment.question: How can I pay my tuition fees?
tuition_payment.answer: You may pay via: 1) Online bank transfer (BDO/BPI), 2) Over-the-counter at the Cashier's Office, 3) GCash or Maya. Full payment gets 2% discount. Installment plans available: 3-payment scheme (40%-30%-30%).

class_schedule.question: Where can I see my class schedule?
class_schedule.answer: Class schedules are released 3 days before classes start. Log in to the Student Portal using your student ID and password. If unavailable, visit your department office.

contact_info.question: How do I contact the Registrar's Office?
contact_info.answer: Email: registrar@school.edu.ph | Phone: (02) 1234-5678 | Office Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. Located at the Main Building, Ground Floor.
